title: Every Hour Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Next door to the charming Seaside chapel - 2 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes - Walking distance to the Seaside shops and restaurants - Access to the Seaside private beaches via the East Ruskin Access Location - You will have 2 RFID access card for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $28/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. --Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($50 fee applies at booking) Every Hour follows these guest cottage guidelines allowing for a kitchen with full-size fridge, oven, stove-top, toaster oven, and coffee maker. Please note there is no dishwasher. The living room boasts a 47-inch flat screen TV, love seat, and bar stools to eat in the kitchen. French doors open this living space up onto your private veranda with additional table and chairs for dining Al Fresco! A spiral staircase takes you up to the QUEEN master retreat with private bath (shower only). There is an additional flat screen TV in the bedroom and additional french doors that take you out to a private balcony. Please note that the bathroom is on the smaller side for those over 6ft tall, but Every Hour offers an outdoor shower as well that allows you to live like a true 30A local and shower outside! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 2) First floor- Kitchen and great room with TV 2nd floor- Bedroom 1: Queen, w/ private bathroom (shower only) 'Every Hour' is a charming one-bedroom guest cottage to parent cottage, 'It's Happy Hour'. And as you can tell from the cottage names, every hour is a happy one when you stay here! Located on Forest Street and to the left of the Seaside Chapel, 'Every Hour' is just a couple short blocks from the beach and an even shorter walk to Seaside's bustling town square. Guest cottages along 30A are a great way for couples to get to experience iconic beach towns like Seaside, without breaking the bank. These cottages are intentionally appointed with smaller kitchens, living spaces, and bathrooms but allow a place to rest your head after a fun-filled day at the beach, or enjoy a cocktail on your veranda before heading out to a delicious 30A meal. And the best part is all of these things are walkable or bike-able from your adorable little bungalow! There is also a private grill and additional outdoor seating off the front of the cottage. Every Hour tends to be a quieter spot to stay due to the fact that it is beside the Seaside Chapel. You are also centrally located between the 3 Seaside Pools, tennis courts, croquet lawn, playground and basketball court. All is just a short walk from your cottage! IMPORTANT DETAILS * Parking for 1 car * Sorry, no pets allowed ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $28/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Please note that this cottage does not have a washer/dryer on site. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market.
